_comment: One entry per touch. `angle` steers the copy; the LLM never decides who or when.

touches.angle: First contact. Reference something specific about what the company is building. State the reason for reaching out in one sentence. Ask for a 15-minute call. No pitch deck language, no superlatives.
Short nudge on the first email. Add exactly one new piece of substance they did not have before. Under 60 words.
Different angle from touches 1 and 2. Lead with a concrete observation about their market or stage. Still ask for 15 minutes.
Final message. Say plainly this is the last one, leave the door open, and do not ask a question that requires a reply.
